description: Header file defining the RocketConsoleTextElement class, which manages console text display in a UI using RmlUi. It includes a ConsoleLine struct, class methods for updating and property changes, and handles rendering console lines with font metrics.

classes.name: RocketConsoleTextElement
classes.description: A UI element class for rendering console text lines with dynamic updates and font handling.

methods.name: OnUpdate
methods.description: Updates the console display, removing old lines, adding new ones, and adjusting max lines based on font height.

methods.name: OnPropertyChange
methods.description: Handles property changes, specifically updating the height property to recalculate layout.
